scope: The steps from the destination_v9 checkpoint (PR 88) to the destination_v29 update-600 checkpoint: a derived starting checkpoint with the ghost_v11 inputs and two native Spark trainings, each started from the previous checkpoint. Checkpoints and raw runs stay on Spark under /srv/cupi/hexapod/runs/julian.

chain.description: Give the policy the ghost's sideways gap, along-track gap and relative velocity (ghost_v11)
chain.change: make_ghost_v11_start.py widens the first actor and critic layers from v9's 5 ghost inputs to 9: the sideways and along-track gaps both take the gap's weights (they sum to the gap) and the two relative-velocity inputs start at zero, so the derived checkpoint acts as v9 does (to 1e-6 on the surrogate). Its declaration keeps v9's identity and records the derivation.

chain.description: Learn to walk up to 0.15 m/s with a speed curriculum
chain.change: destination_v25: every command a walk in a uniform direction, a fifth stopping after 4-12 s; the top speed starts at 0.075 m/s and rises by 0.025 m/s to 0.15 m/s once, over the last 30 updates, no robot fell, every finished walk passed the evaluator's moving checks and the gap to the ghost moved less than about 5 mm from each walk's halfway to its end; the gait cycle shortens with speed (speed_v1: 60 controls at 0.075 m/s to 40 at 0.15 m/s); the ghost pay turns linear past 20 mm and becomes a charge of up to -1; a charge of -0.5 min(planar error / evaluator bound, 2) per walking control; learning-rate floor 2e-5.

training.learner_arguments: --updates 5000 --seed 20260917 --extended-updates --recipe none --action-mean tanh --observation-normalization none --observation-scaling fixed --command-segments bootstrap --learning-rate-max 0.0001 --learning-rate-min 2e-05 --action-std 0.05 --action-std-final 0.05 --gait-clock 60 --action-smoothing mean2 --velocity-noise 0.5 --steps-per-env 36 --experiment destination_v25 --initialize-from /checkpoint/v9_ghost_v11.pt --initialize-from-sha256 41e0e7c502ef25a3e477022e450e4445a7c2d6582c2c02b317c1ac519b84da4e --initialize-from-declaration-sha256 83c43acb20b64f36e50f930668964bee7abff3dc7efaa5e09f470997db140c24

chain.note: Mastered 0.15 m/s at update 1341; update 1350 is the first checkpoint after. The run continued to its 6 h wall limit at update 4381 (recorded as failed, exit 1); the curriculum's drift score fell from 0.87 to 0.49 after update 2600.

chain.description: Fine-tune stopping, standing and turning in place, and pay the ghost gap at each run's end
chain.change: destination_v29: runs drawn as 10% turns in place at 0.2 rad/s for 20 s, 10% stands of 20 s or 32 s, 50% walks of 4-12 s then a stop for the rest of 20 s, and 30% 20 s walks, in uniform directions at 0.05-0.15 m/s; episodes up to 32 s; an added run-end pay share_done * max(1 - gap / 25 mm, -1); termination 52; learning rate 2e-5 from the checkpoint, action deviation 0.05.
